Fortinet is hiring an early-career Software Developer Engineer to develop and maintain software for FortiSwitch products and networking features across hardware and virtual machine platforms. The role also focuses on debugging and resolving defects, delivering software features, and supporting integration and validation in Linux environments.
Cyber Security
Apps

Network Security
Security

No H1B
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain software components for FortiSwitch products
Participate in the development of networking-related features for FortiSwitch hardware and virtual machine (FSW-VM) platforms
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects in shipping FortiSwitch products
Hands-on bug fixing and issue resolution for current FortiSwitch products
Design, implement, test, and deliver software features with high quality and on schedule
Write clean, maintainable, and high-quality C/C++ code
Support integration and validation of networking features in Linux environments
Work with senior engineers to troubleshoot software, system, and networking issues
Collaborate with software, QA, and hardware teams throughout the development lifecycle
Communicate technical issues and project status effectively in both verbal and written formats

Strong programming skills in C/C++
Experience developing software in Linux or Unix environments
Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, testing, and version control
Basic understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, Ethernet Switching, VLANs, Routing, and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking
Familiarity with socket programming
Exposure to scripting languages such as Python or Shell scripting
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as KVM or VMware
Exposure to Linux kernel internals or device drivers
Understanding of networking protocols such as STP/RSTP, LACP, LLDP, OSPF, or BGP
Experience using Git and collaborative software development tools
Experience with automated testing or CI/CD environments
Knowledge of AI-assisted software development tools
